question: Who is in this public group or queue, and which objects does the queue serve?

steps.name: grp
steps.soql: SELECT Id, DeveloperName, Name, Type FROM Group WHERE DeveloperName = '{group}'

steps.name: members
steps.soql: SELECT UserOrGroupId, GroupId FROM GroupMember WHERE GroupId IN ({@grp.Id})

steps.name: users
steps.soql: SELECT Name, Username, IsActive FROM User WHERE Id IN ({@members.UserOrGroupId}) ORDER BY Name

steps.name: queue_objects
steps.soql: SELECT SobjectType FROM QueueSobject WHERE QueueId IN ({@grp.Id})

verdicts.say: {group} has {members.rows} member(s): {users.rows} user(s), the rest are groups or roles.
